<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Implement the TP1 fixed-slot recovery lifecycle proposed in #35376, building
on #39834.

This draft is logically dependent on #39834 and currently includes its
unmerged commit stack because GitHub cannot use another contributor's fork
branch as a pull-request base.

This draft now implements same-global-rank replacement using Mooncake for
recoverable process-group membership and the existing NIXL MoE endpoint APIs.
Runtime GPU/RDMA proof remains pending.

## Modifications

### Delivered in this draft

- Validates and binds runtime instance, topology generation, operation ID,
  allocation ID, and fixed global EP rank.
- Fences dispatch to the failed slot and disconnects its NIXL peers.
- Publishes replacement endpoint data in operation- and allocation-scoped
  TCPStore namespaces, preventing stale endpoint reuse.
- Reconnects replacement and survivor ranks through the existing two-sided
  `connect_ranks()` flow and waits for per-rank acknowledgements.
- Runs a correlated internal warmup before reporting `ready`.
- Retires completed local NIXL recovery state so a later replacement can be
  admitted.
- Adds CPU lifecycle/correlation tests and a manual same-rank replacement
  failure-injection test.

### Current limitations

- Recovery is limited to TP1 fixed slots.
- The supported composition is Mooncake process-group recovery with NIXL MoE
  communication. Pure NIXL/NCCL process-group recovery is not implemented.
- No GPU/RDMA two-allocation replacement end-to-end test has run.
- The local cross-VM evidence harness is prepared but intentionally not part of
  this PR. A NIXL API change will only be proposed if that run yields a minimal
  NIXL-only failing reproducer.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This change does not alter model-output algorithms.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. The recovery worker runs only for an admitted recovery operation.

## Validation

```console
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/python python3 -m pytest \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_elastic_ep_lifecycle.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_elastic_ep_runtime_topology.py -q
```

Result: 48 passed, 22 warnings, and 3 subtests passed in a Linux container.

Targeted `ruff`, `ruff-format`, `isort`, Python compilation, and
`git diff --check` also passed.

## Pending validation

Run the prepared two-VM GPU/RDMA pod-death test to prove stale-endpoint
fencing, two-sided reconnection, recovered-rank dispatch, warmup, and
readiness. Existing NIXL APIs remain the implementation candidate unless a
minimal NIXL-only reproducer proves an API gap.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). Targeted `ruff-format` and `isort` passed.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). `PYTHONPATH=/workspace/python python3 -m pytest test/registered/unit/managers/test_elastic_ep_lifecycle.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_elastic_ep_runtime_topology.py -q` passed: 48 tests and 3 subtests.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). Targeted `ruff`, `ruff-format`, `isort`, compilation, and `git diff --check` passed.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import threading
+import time
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, replace
+from datetime import timedelta
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import quote
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed.utils import get_global_tcp_store
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+_RUNTIME_TOPOLOGY_KEY = "elastic_ep/runtime_topology"
+_MEMBERSHIP_OBSERVATION_KEY_PREFIX = "elastic_ep/membership_observation"
+_MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH_KEY_PREFIX = "elastic_ep/membership_epoch"
+_MEMBERSHIP_LATEST_KEY_PREFIX = "elastic_ep/membership_latest"
+_MEMBERSHIP_SLOT_KEY_PREFIX = "elastic_ep/membership_slot"
+_MEMBERSHIP_PUBLICATION_LOCK = threading.RLock()
+
+
+class ElasticEPRecoveryRequiredError(RuntimeError):
+    """The requested rank range belonged to an earlier topology."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RuntimeTopology:
+    runtime_instance_id: str
+    initial_ep_size: int
+    allocation_width: int
+    effective_ep_size: int
+    max_committed_ep_size: int
+    topology_generation: int = 0
+
+    def validate(self) -> None:
+        if not self.runtime_instance_id:
+            raise ValueError("Elastic EP runtime instance ID must not be empty.")
+        if self.initial_ep_size <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Elastic EP initial size must be positive.")
+        if self.allocation_width <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Elastic EP allocation width must be positive.")
+        if self.initial_ep_size % self.allocation_width != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Elastic EP initial size must be divisible by the allocation "
+                f"width (initial={self.initial_ep_size}, "
+                f"width={self.allocation_width})."
+            )
+        if not (0 < self.effective_ep_size <= self.max_committed_ep_size):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Elastic EP runtime topology requires "
+                "0 < effective_ep_size <= max_committed_ep_size "
+                f"(effective={self.effective_ep_size}, "
+                f"max_committed={self.max_committed_ep_size})."
+            )
+        if self.topology_generation < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Elastic EP topology generation must be non-negative.")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MembershipObservation:
+    runtime_instance_id: str
+    topology_generation: int
+    rank: int
+    failed_allocation_incarnation: str
+    membership_epoch: int
+
+    def validate(self, topology: RuntimeTopology) -> None:
+        if self.runtime_instance_id != topology.runtime_instance_id:
+            raise ValueError("Membership observation runtime instance is stale.")
+        if self.topology_generation != topology.topology_generation:
+            raise ValueError("Membership observation topology generation is stale.")
+        if self.rank < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Membership observation rank must be non-negative.")
+        if self.rank >= topology.max_committed_ep_size:
+            raise ValueError("Membership observation rank is outside the topology.")
+        if not self.failed_allocation_incarnation:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Membership observation allocation incarnation is required."
+            )
+        if self.membership_epoch < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Membership observation epoch must be non-negative.")
+
+
+def _membership_observation_key(observation: MembershipObservation) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"{_MEMBERSHIP_OBSERVATION_KEY_PREFIX}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/"
+        f"{observation.topology_generation}/"
+        f"{observation.rank}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.failed_allocation_incarnation, safe='')}/"
+        f"{observation.membership_epoch}"
+    )
+
+
+def _membership_epoch_key(observation: MembershipObservation) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"{_MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH_KEY_PREFIX}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/"
+        f"{observation.topology_generation}/"
+        f"{observation.rank}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.failed_allocation_incarnation, safe='')}"
+    )
+
+
+def _membership_latest_key(observation: MembershipObservation) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"{_MEMBERSHIP_LATEST_KEY_PREFIX}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/"
+        f"{observation.topology_generation}"
+    )
+
+
+def _membership_slot_key(observation: MembershipObservation) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"{_MEMBERSHIP_SLOT_KEY_PREFIX}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/"
+        f"{observation.topology_generation}/{observation.rank}"
+    )
+
+
+def _membership_incarnation_key(observation: MembershipObservation) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"{_MEMBERSHIP_SLOT_KEY_PREFIX}/seen/"
+        f"{quote(observation.runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/"
+        f"{observation.topology_generation}/{observation.rank}/"
+        f"{quote(observation.failed_allocation_incarnation, safe='')}"
+    )
+
+
+def publish_membership_observation(
+    observation: MembershipObservation,
+    *,
+    deadline_unix_seconds: Optional[float] = None,
+) -> str:
+    """Publish one CPU-only, monotonic membership observation.
+
+    Publication is serialized so the per-slot incarnation and latest snapshot
+    cannot be observed halfway through an update. Replaying the exact same
+    observation is idempotent so every surviving scheduler can acknowledge a
+    shared publication. The epoch watermark still rejects stale and ABA
+    observations.
+    """
+    topology = get_runtime_topology()
+    if topology is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Elastic EP runtime topology has not been published.")
+    observation.validate(topology)
+    store = get_global_tcp_store()
+    if store is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Elastic EP requires the global TCPStore.")
+
+    with _MEMBERSHIP_PUBLICATION_LOCK:
+        if deadline_unix_seconds is not None and time.time() >= deadline_unix_seconds:
+            raise TimeoutError(
+                "Membership observation expired before publication; "
+                "no state was changed."
+            )
+        observation_key = _membership_observation_key(observation)
+        encoded = json.dumps(asdict(observation), sort_keys=True).encode()
+        if store.check([observation_key]):
+            if store.get(observation_key) != encoded:
+                raise ValueError("Conflicting Elastic EP membership observation.")
+        epoch_key = _membership_epoch_key(observation)
+        slot_key = _membership_slot_key(observation)
+        incarnation_key = _membership_incarnation_key(observation)
+        if store.check([incarnation_key]):
+            current = json.loads(store.get(slot_key).decode())
+            if current["failed_allocation_incarnation"] != (
+                observation.failed_allocation_incarnation
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Stale or ABA Elastic EP membership observation.")
+        if store.check([epoch_key]):
+            previous_epoch = int(store.get(epoch_key).decode())
+            if observation.membership_epoch < previous_epoch:
+                raise ValueError("Stale or ABA Elastic EP membership observation.")
+            if (
+                observation.membership_epoch == previous_epoch
+                and store.check([slot_key])
+                and store.get(slot_key) == encoded
+            ):
+                return observation_key
+        if hasattr(store, "compare_set"):
+            existing = store.compare_set(observation_key, b"", encoded)
+            if existing != encoded:
+                raise ValueError("Conflicting Elastic EP membership observation.")
+            store.set(epoch_key, str(observation.membership_epoch).encode())
+        else:
+            store.set(observation_key, encoded)
+            store.set(epoch_key, str(observation.membership_epoch).encode())
+        store.set(incarnation_key, b"1")
+        store.set(slot_key, encoded)
+        store.set(_membership_latest_key(observation), encoded)
+        return observation_key
+
+
+def get_membership_observation() -> Optional[MembershipObservation]:
+    topology = get_runtime_topology()
+    store = get_global_tcp_store()
+    if topology is None or store is None:
+        return None
+    key = (
+        f"{_MEMBERSHIP_LATEST_KEY_PREFIX}/"
+        f"{quote(topology.runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/"
+        f"{topology.topology_generation}"
+    )
+    if not store.check([key]):
+        return None
+    observation = MembershipObservation(**json.loads(store.get(key).decode()))
+    observation.validate(topology)
+    return observation
+
+
+def _decode_runtime_topology(value: bytes) -> RuntimeTopology:
+    topology = RuntimeTopology(**json.loads(value.decode()))
+    topology.validate()
+    return topology
+
+
+def _read_runtime_topology(store) -> Optional[RuntimeTopology]:
+    if not store.check([_RUNTIME_TOPOLOGY_KEY]):
+        return None
+    return _decode_runtime_topology(store.get(_RUNTIME_TOPOLOGY_KEY))
+
+
+def get_runtime_topology() -> Optional[RuntimeTopology]:
+    store = get_global_tcp_store()
+    if store is None:
+        return None
+    return _read_runtime_topology(store)
+
+
+def publish_runtime_topology(topology: RuntimeTopology) -> None:
+    topology.validate()
+    store = get_global_tcp_store()
+    if store is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Elastic EP requires the global TCPStore.")
+
+    existing = _read_runtime_topology(store)
+    if (
+        existing is not None
+        and existing.runtime_instance_id != topology.runtime_instance_id
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Elastic EP runtime topology already belongs to runtime instance "
+            f"{existing.runtime_instance_id}, not {topology.runtime_instance_id}."
+        )
+    store.set(
+        _RUNTIME_TOPOLOGY_KEY,
+        json.dumps(asdict(topology), sort_keys=True).encode(),
+    )
+
+
+def commit_runtime_topology(effective_ep_size: int) -> RuntimeTopology:
+    topology = get_runtime_topology()
+    if topology is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Elastic EP runtime topology has not been published.")
+    committed = replace(
+        topology,
+        effective_ep_size=effective_ep_size,
+        max_committed_ep_size=max(
+            topology.max_committed_ep_size,
+            effective_ep_size,
+        ),
+        topology_generation=topology.topology_generation + 1,
+    )
+    publish_runtime_topology(committed)
+    return committed
+
+
+def validate_append_candidate(
+    topology: RuntimeTopology,
+    *,
+    rank_offset: int,
+    allocation_width: int,
+    initial_ep_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    if topology.initial_ep_size != initial_ep_size:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Joining allocation initial EP size does not match the running world "
+            f"(joiner={initial_ep_size}, runtime={topology.initial_ep_size})."
+        )
+    if topology.allocation_width != allocation_width:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Joining allocation width does not match the running world "
+            f"(joiner={allocation_width}, runtime={topology.allocation_width})."
+        )
+    if (
+        rank_offset != topology.effective_ep_size
+        or rank_offset != topology.max_committed_ep_size
+    ):
+        raise ElasticEPRecoveryRequiredError(
+            "Elastic EP allocation offset "
+            f"{rank_offset} was previously occupied or is not the next append "
+            "position; recovery mode is required "
+            f"(effective={topology.effective_ep_size}, "
+            f"max_committed={topology.max_committed_ep_size})."
+        )
+

+def probe_runtime_topology(
+    dist_init_addr: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    timeout_seconds: float = 1.0,
+    attempts: int = 3,
+    retry_interval_seconds: float = 0.25,
+) -> Optional[RuntimeTopology]:
+    """Read a running primary's record without creating a CUDA context.
+
+    Absence is expected while a new initial world is still forming. Later
+    append candidates require an authoritative record and reject absence.
+    """
+
+    master_ip = None
+    if dist_init_addr:
+        address = dist_init_addr.removeprefix("tcp://")
+        master_ip = address.rsplit(":", 1)[0]
+    if not master_ip:
+        master_ip = os.environ.get("MASTER_ADDR")
+    if not master_ip:
+        return None
+    if attempts <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Runtime-topology probe attempts must be positive.")
+
+    from torch.distributed import TCPStore
+
+    for attempt in range(attempts):
+        try:
+            store = TCPStore(
+                host_name=master_ip,
+                port=envs.SGLANG_TCP_STORE_PORT.get(),
+                is_master=False,
+                wait_for_workers=False,
+                timeout=timedelta(seconds=timeout_seconds),
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            # A new world has no coordination store until its primary has
+            # formed the distributed runtime. Retry to avoid treating a brief
+            # connection failure as proof that no runtime exists.
+            if attempt + 1 < attempts:
+                time.sleep(retry_interval_seconds)
+            continue
+        return _read_runtime_topology(store)
+    return None

+"""Manual TP1-per-allocation NIXL fixed-slot recovery test.
+
+Run with two visible GPUs:
+
+    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 python -m pytest \
+        test/manual/ep/test_nixl_fixed_slot_recovery.py -v -s
+"""
+
+import os

+import time
+import unittest

+import requests

+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_SMALL_MOE_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST_CHAT,
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+)
+from sglang.utils import wait_for_http_ready
+
+MODEL = os.environ.get(
+    "SGLANG_NIXL_RECOVERY_MODEL", DEFAULT_SMALL_MOE_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST_CHAT
+)
+DIST_INIT_ADDR = os.environ.get("SGLANG_NIXL_RECOVERY_DIST_INIT", "127.0.0.1:26555")
+PRIMARY_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_NIXL_RECOVERY_PRIMARY_PORT", "21000"))
+REPLACEMENT_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_NIXL_RECOVERY_REPLACEMENT_PORT", "22000"))
+RECOVERY_TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("SGLANG_NIXL_RECOVERY_TIMEOUT", "600"))
+INITIAL_ALLOCATION_IDS = ("initial-rank-0", "initial-rank-1")
+REPLACEMENT_ALLOCATION_ID = "replacement-rank-1"
+
+
+def _visible_devices() -> list[str]:
+    configured = os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
+    if configured:
+        return [device.strip() for device in configured.split(",") if device.strip()]
+    try:
+        import torch
+
+        return [str(index) for index in range(torch.cuda.device_count())]
+    except Exception:
+        return []
+
+
+def _server_args(
+    allocation_index: int,
+    allocation_id: str,
+    port: int,
+    *,
+    recover: bool,
+) -> list[str]:
+    args = [
+        "sglang",
+        "serve",
+        "--model-path",
+        MODEL,
+        "--host",
+        "127.0.0.1",
+        "--port",
+        str(port),
+        "--device",
+        "cuda",
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--dist-init-addr",
+        DIST_INIT_ADDR,
+        "--enable-dp-lm-head",
+        "--elastic-ep-backend",
+        "mooncake",
+        "--moe-a2a-backend",
+        "nixl",
+        "--deepep-mode",
+        "low_latency",
+        "--moe-dense-tp-size",
+        "1",
+        "--disable-custom-all-reduce",
+        "--enable-eplb",
+        "--ep-num-redundant-experts",
+        "2",
+        "--elastic-ep-initial-size",
+        "2",
+        "--max-ep-size",
+        "3",
+        "--elastic-ep-allocation-id",
+        allocation_id,
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "disabled",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-decode",
+        "full",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+        "16",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.7",
+    ]
+    if recover:
+        args.extend(
+            [
+                "--tp",
+                "2",
+                "--nnodes",
+                "2",
+                "--node-rank",
+                str(allocation_index),
+                "--attn-dp-size",
+                "2",
+                "--elastic-ep-join-mode",
+                "recover",
+            ]
+        )
+    else:
+        args.extend(
+            [
+                "--elastic-ep-join-mode",
+                "auto",
+                "--elastic-ep-allocation-index",
+                str(allocation_index),
+            ]
+        )
+    return args
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    len(_visible_devices()) >= 2,
+    "NIXL fixed-slot recovery needs two visible GPUs.",
+)
+class TestNixlFixedSlotRecovery(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PRIMARY_PORT}"
+        cls.processes: list[subprocess.Popen] = []
+        cls.logs = []
+        devices = _visible_devices()
+        cls.primary = cls._launch(
+            allocation_index=0,
+            allocation_id=INITIAL_ALLOCATION_IDS[0],
+            port=PRIMARY_PORT,
+            device=devices[0],
+            name="primary",
+        )
+        cls.failed_rank = cls._launch(
+            allocation_index=1,
+            allocation_id=INITIAL_ALLOCATION_IDS[1],
+            port=REPLACEMENT_PORT,
+            device=devices[1],
+            name="initial-rank-1",
+        )
+        wait_for_http_ready(
+            f"{cls.base_url}/health_generate",
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            process=cls.primary,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _launch(
+        cls,
+        *,
+        allocation_index: int,
+        allocation_id: str,
+        port: int,
+        device: str,
+        name: str,
+        recover: bool = False,
+    ) -> subprocess.Popen:
+        log_path = Path(f"/tmp/nixl_fixed_slot_{name}_{int(time.time())}.log")
+        log_file = open(log_path, "w")
+        env = os.environ.copy()
+        env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = device
+        env["SGLANG_NIXL_EP_BF16_DISPATCH"] = "1"
+        process = subprocess.Popen(
+            _server_args(allocation_index, allocation_id, port, recover=recover),
+            env=env,
+            stdout=log_file,
+            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+        )
+        cls.processes.append(process)
+        cls.logs.append(log_file)
+        print(f"Started {name}; log: {log_path}")
+        return process
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        for process in reversed(getattr(cls, "processes", [])):
+            if process.poll() is None:
+                terminate_and_kill_process_tree(process)
+        for log_file in getattr(cls, "logs", []):
+            log_file.close()
+
+    def _generate(self, routed_dp_rank: int = 0) -> requests.Response:
+        return requests.post(
+            f"{self.base_url}/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": "The capital of France is",
+                "sampling_params": {"max_new_tokens": 4, "temperature": 0.0},
+                "routed_dp_rank": routed_dp_rank,
+            },
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+
+    def _state(self) -> dict:
+        response = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}/is_scaling_elastic_ep", timeout=30)
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+        return response.json()
+
+    def _publish_stale_endpoint(self, runtime_instance_id: str) -> None:
+        host, port = DIST_INIT_ADDR.rsplit(":", 1)
+        store = dist.TCPStore(
+            host,
+            int(port),
+            world_size=None,
+            is_master=False,
+            wait_for_workers=False,
+        )
+        prefix = (
+            "elastic_ep/nixl_recovery/"
+            f"{quote(runtime_instance_id, safe='')}/0/"
+            f"{quote('stale-operation', safe='')}/"
+            f"{quote(INITIAL_ALLOCATION_IDS[1], safe='')}/"
+        )
+        dist.PrefixStore(prefix, store).set("NIXL_EP/1", b"stale-endpoint")
+
+    def test_same_rank_replacement(self):
+        response = self._generate()
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+        terminate_and_kill_process_tree(self.failed_rank)
+        response = self._generate()
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+        operation_id = f"recover-rank-1-{int(time.time())}"
+        response = requests.post(
+            f"{self.base_url}/recover_elastic_ep",
+            json={
+                "operation_id": operation_id,
+                "topology_generation": 0,
+                "allocation_id": REPLACEMENT_ALLOCATION_ID,
+                "rank_offset": 1,
+            },
+            timeout=30,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+        self._publish_stale_endpoint(self._state()["instance_id"])
+
+        self.replacement = self._launch(
+            allocation_index=1,
+            allocation_id=REPLACEMENT_ALLOCATION_ID,
+            port=REPLACEMENT_PORT,
+            device=_visible_devices()[1],
+            name="replacement",
+            recover=True,
+        )
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + RECOVERY_TIMEOUT
+        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            self.assertIsNone(
+                self.replacement.poll(), "Replacement exited before readiness."
+            )
+            state = self._state()
+            if state["recovery_phase"] == "ready":
+                self.assertTrue(state["recovery_succeeded"])
+                response = self._generate(routed_dp_rank=1)
+                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+                return
+            self.assertNotEqual(state["recovery_phase"], "failed", state)
+            time.sleep(2)
+        self.fail(f"Timed out waiting for recovery readiness: {self._state()}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

[P1] Do not wait for a reply from the failed rank

This registers recovery with the normal full-worker fan-out, but `DataParallelController.send_control_message()` dispatches only to `_active_workers`, which excludes workers whose health status is false. `TokenizerManager.update_active_ranks()` does not reduce this communicator's expected reply count. Recovery admission needs a correlated set of surviving recipients and a matching expected reply set; it cannot require the failed allocation to acknowledge its own recovery.

[P1] Support warmup when tokenizer initialization is skipped

With `--skip-tokenizer-init`, scheduler initialization sets `self.tokenizer = None`. [P1] Verify recovered membership before reporting ready

A matching request finishing without `FINISH_ABORT` does not establish that the replacement slot is still active. The elastic forward path can rebalance after a rank fault and rerun a forward on surviving ranks. If the replacement fails during warmup, that request can still finish normally, and this callback calls `complete_recovery_warmup(success=True)` and publishes `ready` without checking the recovered slot or current topology. [P1] Keep the retained scale result separate from recovery

`operation_succeeded` and `last_error` belong to the retained scale operation, whose `operation_id` is unchanged here. [P1] Release pending-operation exclusion after recovery finishes

Every recovery phase other than `idle` is treated as a pending recovery here, and `request_scale()` has the same exclusion. Successful warmup leaves the phase at `ready`, with no subsequent reset or terminal-phase exception. After one successful recovery, a different recovery always conflicts and every later scale request is rejected. An aborted warmup similarly leaves scheduler state at `warming_up`, even though the tokenizer receives a terminal failure. Please distinguish terminal recovery results from an in-flight recovery, retain the result for same-operation retries, and allow a new operation after completion or failure.

[P1] Reconcile unknown recovery submissions on retry

After the communicator times out or is cancelled, this method records `submission_unknown` with no terminal result. An identical retry returns through this cached-state branch without querying or resubmitting to the scheduler, while a different operation is rejected as pending. Please reconcile scheduler acceptance using the same immutable operation identity, as the scale submission path already does, rather than returning an unknown state forever.

inline_comments.body:
[P2] Let terminal recovery completion win over late acceptance

While the communicator is awaited, `forward_elastic_scale_update()` can receive the terminal recovery update and set the phase to `ready` and the result to successful. When the awaited acceptance responses subsequently return, this unconditional assignment overwrites the phase with their earlier `restoring` value. Status and retries can then permanently show `recovery_succeeded=True` but `recovery_phase=restoring`, with no later update to correct it. Please preserve a terminal result that arrived during submission and return that result instead of the stale acceptance response.

[P2] Run the async recovery fan-out test in an async-aware test case

`TestElasticEPRecoveryLifecycle` inherits from `unittest.TestCase`, but this test is `async def`. The unittest runner calls it without awaiting the returned coroutine, so its body and assertions never execute; depending on warning policy, it can still be counted as a passing test. A focused reproduction confirms the test passes without even calling `_manager()`. Please move this test into `unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase` (as the existing async lifecycle tests use), or use another runner that actually awaits it.

+                self.elastic_recovery_phase = failed.recovery_phase

+            self.elastic_recovery_phase = responses[0].recovery_phase

+                RecoveryOperation(
+                    runtime_instance_id="runtime-1",
+                    topology_generation=3,
+                    operation_id="recover-width",
+                    allocation_id="pod-uid-5",
+                    rank_offset=2,
+                )
+            )
+
+    def test_ready_requires_explicit_successful_internal_warmup(self):
+        lifecycle = RecoveryLifecycle()
+
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Invalid"):
+            lifecycle.advance("ready", warmup_succeeded=True)
+        lifecycle.advance("slot_restored")
+        lifecycle.advance("warming_up")
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "warmup"):
+            lifecycle.advance("ready", warmup_succeeded=False)
+        lifecycle.advance("ready", warmup_succeeded=True)
+
+        self.assertEqual(lifecycle.phase, "ready")
+
+    def test_recovery_state_requires_the_matching_warmup_operation(self):
+        operation = RecoveryOperation(
+            runtime_instance_id="runtime-1",
+            topology_generation=3,
+            operation_id="recover-1",
+            allocation_id="pod-uid-5",
+            rank_offset=2,
+        )
+        ElasticEPStateManager.request_recovery(operation)
+        ElasticEPStateManager.mark_recovery_slot_restored()
+        self.assertTrue(ElasticEPStateManager.begin_recovery_warmup("recover-1"))
+        self.assertFalse(
+            ElasticEPStateManager.complete_recovery_warmup(
+                "stale-recovery", success=True
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self.state.recovery_phase, "warming_up")
+        self.assertFalse(
+            ElasticEPStateManager.complete_recovery_warmup(
+                "recover-1", success=False
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self.state.recovery_phase, "warming_up")
+        self.assertTrue(
+            ElasticEPStateManager.complete_recovery_warmup(
+                "recover-1", success=True
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self.state.recovery_phase, "ready")
+
+    def test_scheduler_warmup_completion_requires_a_successful_normal_request(self):
+        scheduler = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)

@julienmancuso @zackyoray, update:

1. Implemented existing-API same-rank NIXL replacement.
2. Added CPU orchestration/correlation coverage and direct post-recovery
   inference to the recovered rank.
3. Validation passed: 48 tests, 3 subtests, lint, format, and compilation.
4. The two-node GPU/RDMA failure-injection harness is implemented; execution
   is pending.
5. I will propose NIXL changes only if a minimal NIXL-only reproducer proves
   an existing-API gap.

I ran the supplied two-node Kubernetes recovery harness against pinned head `a67e78ec0fd80d1ab34b12a857545610bd9e53ab` on October 14. Both attempts stopped during argument resolution, before baseline inference or failure injection. **NIXL recovery remains unvalidated.**

Image digest, base build commit, PR import provenance, GPU visibility, and active configured InfiniBand ports were verified on two distinct nodes. These device checks do not establish cross-node RDMA transfer. The run used checksum-verified PR Python source on the pinned official image, not a container built wholly from the PR:
```text
base_commit=e6072935bfa1036d4e20e8ed042ce1ff09872f57
pr_overlay_commit=a67e78ec0fd80d1ab34b12a857545610bd9e53ab
sglang_module=/opt/pr-source/python/sglang/__init__.py
```

### 1. Harness arguments conflict with automatic bootstrap

The supplied harness combines `--elastic-ep-join-mode auto` with `--tp 2 --nnodes 2 --attn-dp-size 2`, plus `--node-rank 1` for the second allocation. The first attempt rejected these:
```text
ValueError: --elastic-ep-join-mode auto owns TP, DP, EP, node, rank-offset, and local-device geometry; remove conflicting arguments: --tp-size=2, --attn-dp-size=2, --nnodes=2.
```
The rank-1 error additionally lists `--node-rank=1`.

I removed those explicit geometry arguments only for the initial `auto` allocations, retaining the allocation indices, initial size 2, maximum size 3, and the existing recovery-joiner geometry. No SGLang production source was patched.

### 2. The corrected launch hits an EPLB/auto resolution-order failure

Both initial allocations then exit with:
```text
File "/opt/pr-source/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/pipeline.py", line 283, in run_resolution_pipeline
    run_hook(handle_eplb_and_dispatch, server_args)
File "/opt/pr-source/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/parallel_hook.py", line 896, in handle_eplb_and_dispatch
    assert resolved_view(server_args).ep_size > 1
AssertionError
```

In the pinned [resolution pipeline](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/a67e78ec0fd80d1ab34b12a857545610bd9e53ab/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/pipeline.py#L283), `handle_eplb_and_dispatch` runs before `handle_elastic_ep` (line 285). With `--enable-eplb` and `auto` mode, EP size is still its default of 1 when the [assertion](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/a67e78ec0fd80d1ab34b12a857545610bd9e53ab/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/parallel_hook.py#L895) runs; automatic geometry has not yet been derived. Restoring explicit geometry is not a workaround because automatic mode rejects it.

Please resolve automatic geometry before validations that depend on it and add coverage through the complete argument-resolution pipeline with `auto` + `--enable-eplb` + NIXL. The current [auto-bootstrap tests](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/a67e78ec0fd80d1ab34b12a857545610bd9e53ab/test/registered/unit/server_args/test_elastic_ep_auto_bootstrap.py) call `handle_elastic_ep` directly, so they do not exercise this ordering.

Logs and manifests from both attempts were retained locally, and all test pods and Services were cleaned up. The result is **INCONCLUSIVE for recovery**, not evidence of a NIXL API failure.
